images.note: IRAM04191. Matched to atlas system IRAM 04191+1522 by name; note the Podio+2021 pointing (04:21:56.9 +15:29:46) is ~62 arcsec from the atlas system coordinate - verify. CO detected; SO and SiO are imaged non-detections (continuum only). Epoch from Maury et al. 2019 (A&A 621, A76) Table 7 observing log for the same CALYPSO tracks; Podio+2021 itself only gives the survey span Sep 2010 - Mar 2013.
